summary: Hafnia Ltd, a Singapore-based tanker operator, filed a 6-K on September 3, 2026 disclosing the board's decision to accelerate vesting of share options and restricted share units held by departing CEO Mikael Skov, who stepped down effective September 1, 2026. Skov held 2,159,127 unvested options and 60,974 RSUs; following acceleration, he holds vested rights to 2,220,101 shares. Options remain subject to original exercise prices. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Form 6-K, referencing the earlier June 30, 2026 announcement. CEO succession is complete, with Soren Steenberg Jensen now CEO. What to watch: any further board or governance changes following the transition.
